categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Anlogic Infotech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) chips, FPSoC (Field Programmable System on Chip) chips, and dedicated EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software. Its products serve diverse applications including communication, industrial, medical, audio-visual broadcasting, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, data centers, and testing and verification. The company also provides modular application IP and reference designs to accelerate customer product development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced FPGA and FPSoC chip design technologies, including integration of ARM and RISC-V processors, high-performance IP cores, and AI-enhanced EDA software tools. It uses a fabless model outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries. Key technologies include high-speed interfaces (MIPI, SerDes), high-precision ADCs, clock network design, and chip testing innovations. The EDA software supports full FPGA design flow with AI acceleration and debugging tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial, communication, automotive electronics, power energy, data centers, consumer electronics, and emerging sectors like machine vision, smart manufacturing, and medical devices. The company serves over 2,000 customers, including major industry leaders, primarily through distributors. It has expanded its automotive FPGA ecosystem and achieved significant breakthroughs in multiple application scenarios.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in the domestic Chinese market with growing international presence. It has established sales networks and strategic partnerships overseas to promote global business expansion. Its subsidiaries are located in China (Shanghai, Chengdu) and Hong Kong, with financial reporting in RMB and USD for overseas entities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Anlogic operates as a fabless semiconductor company focusing on chip design and development. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. The company maintains close collaboration with upstream suppliers and downstream customers, ensuring supply chain stability and efficient product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high R&D investment, focusing on advancing FPGA and FPSoC chip architectures, expanding product portfolios, and enhancing dedicated EDA software capabilities with AI integration. It emphasizes developing automotive-grade chips, high-performance IP cores, and comprehensive application solutions. The strategy includes broadening market applications, deepening industry collaborations, and accelerating international expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of FPGA and FPSoC chips and licensing of dedicated EDA software. Additional income comes from technical services and support. The company sells mainly through distributors and direct sales channels, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The FPGA industry is highly concentrated with global leaders like AMD (Xilinx) and Altera dominating market share. Shanghai Anlogic is a leading domestic FPGA design company in China, actively closing the gap with international competitors by focusing on innovation, product diversification, and expanding application fields. It holds a competitive position in the domestic market with growing recognition and awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 651.8 million, a 6.99% decrease year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 205.1 million. R&D expenses accounted for 55.77% of revenue, reflecting sustained high investment. The company’s total assets were RMB 1.39 billion with net assets of RMB 1.22 billion. Product shipment volumes increased significantly, indicating growth potential despite current profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Anlogic emphasizes its deep technological accumulation, comprehensive product matrix, and integrated hardware-software solutions to deliver high-quality, flexible, and customizable FPGA and FPSoC products. Its unique value lies in combining advanced chip design with proprietary AI-enhanced EDA software and extensive application IP, enabling rapid customer product development and adaptation to diverse market needs. The company also highlights its strong talent pool, robust quality management, and sustainable innovation capabilities.
